title: Energy Shift Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the energy shift E' due to the electric field must be derived and presented.

title: Dipole Moment Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the dipole moment P_n in the presence of the electric field must be derived and presented.

title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The Hamiltonian must be correctly formulated, including the perturbation term due to the electric field.

title: Expectation Value Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the expectation value <x> in state n must be correctly shown.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the energy shift or dipole moment calculations must be avoided.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All quantities must be presented with correct units, ensuring dimensional consistency throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: Consideration of limiting cases or special scenarios that could affect the results should be mentioned.
